# Make It Live

> Make It Live is a Belgian event agency for DJs, live musicians, live bands, performers and photo & video, for corporate events, weddings, festivals and private parties. One team, one point of contact, from the first idea to the last track. Everything else an event needs (technicians, sound & light, decoration, catering, stage & build-up and more) is arranged through a network of partners ("Full event support"). Tagline: "You bring the people. We Make It Live."

Make It Live (Dutch: Belgisch eventbureau) works in Dutch and English. Every page exists in both languages on its own address.

## Pages

- [Homepage, Dutch](https://www.makeitlive.agency/): what Make It Live does, who it is for and the contact form
- [Homepage, English](https://www.makeitlive.agency/en/): the same in English
- [Privacyverklaring](https://www.makeitlive.agency/privacy): how personal data is handled (Dutch)
- [Privacy statement](https://www.makeitlive.agency/en/privacy): how personal data is handled (English)

## What we do

- DJs: from warm lounge sets to a packed dance floor
- Live musicians: soloists and duos for ceremonies, dinners and receptions
- Live bands: full bands for parties, receptions and festivals
- Performers: dancers, acts and show elements
- Photo, video and content: photos, video, reels and aftermovies of your event
- Full event support: technicians, sound & light, decoration, food & hospitality, catering, event production, event experience, stage & build-up and more, through partners

## Contact

- Email: bookings@makeitlive.agency
- Contact form on the homepage; we reply within one working day
